messages:
cal: Heads-up — us-west1-a is seeing GPU egress congestion, warm-pool requeues spiked ~8x in the last 15m. Pre-fill attempts are timing out and allocator is retrying. Can we throttle warm-pool prefill and consider routing overflow to us-west2? @lee @maya
lee: Looking now. Pulling allocator + egress metrics. Any noisy tenant IDs visible?
maya: Saw a big KV-cache regen from tenant:searchlytics-ops; long-lived large-embedding batches. They account for ~70% of the egress burst.
pj: Quick mitigation: reduce warm_pool.prefill_concurrency from 3 -> 1 and lower default batch_size for warmers. That should cut steady-state egress without moving traffic.
cal: Good call. Note cross-region fallbacks to us-west2 will add egress cost — rough estimate +$2.5k/day if we shift ~20% of warm-pool traffic. Fine as emergency but prefer throttling first.
lee: Agree. Pushing a config change to limit prefill concurrency. If requeues don't drop in 10m we failover some dedicated slices.
deploy-bot: Started rollout warmpool-prefill-limiter -> configmap/warmpool-config (canary 10%) :rocket:
maya: Monitoring logs + egress counters. Also adding a temporary denylist for searchlytics-ops warmers (will only affect best-effort pools).
cal: Filed INFRA-3421 to track follow-up (kv-cache tuning + tenant outreach).
pj: If we still see tail spikes after throttle, we can also enable prefix-KV caching clamp for that tenant (low-risk).
lee: Requeues down to 1.3x after config change — looks promising. I'll hold off on cross-region shift for now.
maya: :thumbsup: I'll keep an eye for any perf regressions, and ping if anything flares up.
cal: Thanks all — will update INFRA-3421 with cost/impact numbers later today.
lee: Leaving oncall tag. If this ramps again, @pj do you want me to trigger slice re-route to us-west2?
pj: Yes, go ahead if requeues >2x for 15m. Otherwise continue monitoring.
